question_cn: J 组头名（小组赛最终积分榜第一）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group J?
one_liner_cn: 阿根廷以世界第二的 Elo 碾压同组三队，梅西伤愈进入名单，而奥地利核心鲍姆加特纳伤退——约九成概率头名出线。
one_liner_en: Argentina's world-No.2 Elo towers over the group, Messi is fit and in the squad, and Austria has lost Baumgartner — roughly a nine-in-ten chance to top Group J.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距悬殊：阿根廷 2115（世界第 2），领先组内第二的奥地利（1830）285 分；10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟中阿根廷 87.9% 拿下小组头名。
key_reasons.en: Massive Elo gap: Argentina 2115 (world #2), 285 points clear of Austria (1830), the group's next best; Argentina tops the group in 87.9% of 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 阿根廷无人员危机：梅西 5 月底腿筋不适后已伤愈复出，热身赛对冰岛进球，正常进入 26 人名单。
key_reasons.en: No Argentina availability crisis: Messi recovered from his late-May hamstring issue, scored in the final friendly vs Iceland, and is in the 26-man squad.

key_reasons.cn: 最大挑战者被削弱：奥地利核心进攻中场鲍姆加特纳大腿拉伤，确认缺席整届世界杯且不递补（调整 −2pp）。
key_reasons.en: Top challenger weakened: Austria's key attacking midfielder Baumgartner is out of the entire tournament with a thigh injury and no replacement was called up (−2pp adjustment).

method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: Austria −2.0pp for Baumgartner ruled out (no replacement), renormalized to sum 1; all deltas within ±4pp. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data used.
